Today's 08:30 EDT ECI release reported civilian compensation +0.8% quarterly and +3.4% annually, versus +0.9% quarterly previously. [BLS release](https://www.bls.gov/news.release/eci.nr0.htm). Yesterday's September PCE release showed headline inflation +0.5% monthly/+3.6% annually and core +0.3%/+3.1%, while real spending increased less than 0.1%. Slower compensation growth is countered by persistent consumer inflation and weak real spending; consensus surprises are unknown. [BEA release](https://www.bea.gov/news/2026/personal-income-and-outlays-september-2026).

No geopolitical cause was independently verified.

protocol.signals: Prior completed Alpaca IEX daily bars only; provider daily closes are not guaranteed consolidated closing-auction prices. Six fixed rules. Raw reversal is not a classified non-fundamental liquidity shock.
protocol.entry: First observed valid ask from actual market open +5 through +30 minutes, never a reconstructed fill.
protocol.exit: First valid bid from actual close -12 minutes through the close on holding session 1 or 5; missing exits are not evaluable.
protocol.quote_validation: Bid/ask finite, positive, ordered; bid >= $5; quote age between -5 and 90 seconds; spread / midpoint <=0.5% and spread / ask <=0.5%.
protocol.cost_formula: gross=exit_bid/entry_ask-1; net=gross-0.002-(entry_ask-entry_bid)/entry_ask-(exit_ask-exit_bid)/exit_ask; stress=net-0.003. Ask/bid already includes spread; the extra spread terms are conservative additional assumed penalties, not measured fees.
protocol.reporting_window: Twenty broker-calendar entry sessions fixed before the first observation, followed by four possible swing maturation sessions. No optional extension to obtain a winner; descriptive results only.
protocol.denominator: Preregister every eligible rule/symbol/horizon opportunity. Missing prior-session data and non-overlap exclusions are reported separately. Missing entry or exit quotes are not evaluable, never zeros or fills. Net means condition on evaluable observations; show their count against all preregistered opportunities.
protocol.unit: Holding-horizon returns per unit opportunity, cash=0 for observed signal abstentions; average within entry date then across entry dates. Symbols and variants are correlated; entry dates are not proven independent observations.
protocol.comparison: Historical bar-open/close screens differ from this forward quote protocol. They are hypothesis-generation evidence only.
protocol.authority: No broker orders, allocated capital, automatic promotion, causal controls, annualized return or profitability claim.

report.summary: 2026-10-30 initial shortlist: prioritize forward observation of swing reversal; retain breakout, pullback, earnings, macro and options-event hypotheses as research proposals. All six intraday screens lost after base costs; only swing reversal had a positive swing holdout mean. No completed forward sessions exist. No shadow plans: fresh executable levels and current event verification are absent. No new executable contracts are proposed because distinct mechanisms need tested code and parent-version details are unavailable. The eight existing contracts remain unchanged. Research used five searches and five source checks; two checks failed.

hypotheses.claim: Proposed: a prior close above the preceding 20 closes may identify five-session continuation. Contrary evidence: swing breakout holdout mean was -0.18bp after base costs and -3.93bp stressed; swing momentum also lost.
hypotheses.mechanism: Slow information diffusion can sustain trends. The cited momentum research studies persistence over months in futures, not five-session individual-stock breakouts. False breakouts, overnight gaps and turnover can overwhelm continuation.
hypotheses.falsification: Freeze the supplied breakout rule and five-session horizon before forward observation. After at least 20 completed sessions and 30 completed signals, reject the economic shortlist if net mean is nonpositive or fails to improve on the matched unfiltered baseline. Use 20bp base/50bp stressed round-trip assumptions, report cash abstentions separately and account for overlapping holdings and session clusters. Minimum counts alone establish no edge.

hypotheses.claim: Proposed: observe the supplied uptrend-plus-negative-prior-session rule for next-open-to-close recovery. Contrary evidence: intraday pullback lost 4.25bp per unit opportunity in holdout after base costs.
hypotheses.mechanism: Temporary selling pressure may reverse when liquidity returns. Fundamental deterioration can instead continue; bid-ask bounce can resemble recovery. Liquidity-provision research motivates investigation but does not validate this long-only rule.
hypotheses.falsification: Keep the supplied pullback definition fixed and close every observed position that session. Require at least 20 completed forward sessions and 30 completed signals. Reject if net mean remains nonpositive under 20bp base round-trip costs, or apparent recovery disappears using observable ask-to-bid prices. Also report 50bp stress, missing quotes and session-clustered uncertainty.

hypotheses.claim: Highest-priority observation: the supplied prior-three-session-return-below-minus-3% rule had swing holdout means of +8.97bp base and +5.32bp stressed. Contrary evidence: its development stressed mean was slightly negative, and its intraday counterpart lost.
hypotheses.mechanism: Liquidity providers may earn compensation for absorbing temporary selling. News-driven losses need not reverse; high-volatility periods also bring adverse selection, gaps and wider spreads. Published long-short findings do not establish long-only profitability.
hypotheses.falsification: Obtain the exact three-session return; never substitute five-session returns. Preserve the five-session screen horizon. After at least 20 completed sessions and 30 completed signals, reject if net mean is nonpositive after costs or gains depend on one entry-session cluster. Report 20bp/50bp costs, market-relative results, concentration and gap losses. Do not retune on the inspected holdout.

hypotheses.claim: Proposed only: positive first-session reactions following verified earnings releases may continue over five sessions. This is an announcement-reaction hypothesis, not an earnings-surprise signal without timestamped consensus.
hypotheses.mechanism: Gradual interpretation of disclosures may produce continuation. Contrary evidence: the cited study finds drift concentrated in illiquid stocks, with costs absorbing much of paper profits. Large-cap reactions may already incorporate the news; guidance conflicts and gaps can reverse the move.
hypotheses.falsification: Before collection, freeze a protocol requiring an official release timestamp, a positive first full regular-session return, next-session-open observation and five-session holding horizon. Require at least 20 completed sessions and 30 completed events. Reject if net event returns fail to exceed matched non-event observations after 20bp base/50bp stressed costs. Missing release timing means exclusion; this protocol remains proposed pending tested support.

hypotheses.claim: Proposed: test whether a predeclared market-regime gate improves existing long-only intraday candidates. The supplied stock-and-SPY trend screen still lost 11.38bp per unit opportunity in holdout.
hypotheses.mechanism: Unexpected monetary-policy information can change equity risk premiums. A scheduled release or an announced rate level is not itself a measured surprise. Growth information can offset rate effects; daily trend labels may miss rapid event repricing.
hypotheses.falsification: First retrieve the immutable existing regime-contract definitions and parent versions. Collect paired eligible and excluded candidates without redefining risk_on from this paper. After at least 20 completed sessions and 30 eligible candidates, reject the proposed benefit if incremental session-level net return is nonpositive after 20bp/50bp costs. Report participation and absolute returns so fewer losing trades cannot conceal continued losses. Unknown event coverage remains explicit.

hypotheses.claim: SHADOW research only: compare implied volatility before and after verified earnings events. An IV decline does not establish profitable option selling or imply that a correctly directed call will gain.
hypotheses.mechanism: Resolution of event uncertainty can reduce option time value. Contrary outcomes include unexpectedly large jumps, persistent uncertainty and rising post-event IV. Theta, skew, spreads and asynchronous underlying quotes confound comparisons.
hypotheses.falsification: Predeclare matched moneyness, expiry and observation times; capture timestamped two-sided indicative quotes around verified events. Require at least 20 observed sessions and 30 completed events. Reject a systematic-IV-decline claim if matched changes lack a negative event-clustered estimate. Any later payoff analysis must include ask-to-bid round trips, stated fee assumptions and jump tails; no midpoint fills. No option price plans or executable contracts are proposed.

sources.title: What Explains the Stock Market's Reaction to Federal Reserve Policy?
sources.takeaway: Official research abstract links unexpected policy changes to equity-price responses, largely through expected excess returns. Historical average responses are not current trading signals. Timestamp denotes the supplied sprint cutoff.

sources.takeaway: Official educational explanation describes event-related IV repricing that can outweigh a favorable stock move. Its numerical example is hypothetical, not observed evidence of returns. Timestamp denotes the supplied sprint cutoff.

Matching and falsification are sensible, but a reproducible free source of timestamped two-sided quotes and the IV calculation method are unspecified.
